---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(forcats)
library(leaflet)

moments <- read_csv("~/Downloads/wechat_moments_2024_2026_low_frequency.csv")
```
```{r}
moments |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(mean_likes = mean(likes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = country, y = mean_likes)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average WeChat Moments Likes by Country",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Average Number of Likes",
    fill = "Country"
  ) +
    theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
moments |>
  mutate(
    content_category = fct_reorder(
      content_category, likes, .fun = mean
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = content_category, y = likes)) +
  geom_boxplot()
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Likes by Content Category",
    x = "Content Category",
    y = "Number of Likes",
    fill = "Content Category"
  ) +
    theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
#| label: fig-wechat-spatial
#| fig-cap: "Spatial Distribution of WeChat Moments (2024–2026)"
leaflet(moments) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,
    popup = ~location
  )
```

```{r}
moments |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(format(date, "%Y")),
    month = as.integer(format(date, "%m"))
  ) |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarise(
    avg_likes = mean(likes),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = month,
    y = avg_likes,
    color = year,
    group = year
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  labs(
    title = "Average WeChat Moments Likes by Month",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Number of Likes",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
